source.snippet: I liked Duolingo but the practice items are rather short, a word a sentence. I am looking for something that is also gamified but gradually involves the user into longer chunks of text to read and to write, that I can install or self host.

problem_statement: Adult ESL learners want a gamified, progressive writing practice tool that scales from sentences to full paragraphs and essays, but no mainstream app bridges the gap between micro-drill tools like Duolingo and unstructured free writing.
target_segment: Adult non-native English speakers (B1-C1 level) seeking structured, gamified long-form writing practice, including self-hosters
notes: Signals an underserved niche between Duolingo (too short) and essay tutors (too expensive/manual). An AI-powered progressive writing trainer with gamification could be a subscription product.
